title: More Recipes
description: Adds Some New Recipes That Are Good To Have And Are Fair Ffor Previously Uncraftable Items
body:
# **Custom Recipes for the following**


**Armour**
Chain Armour,
Horse Armour (Copper, Iron, Gold, Diamond)

**Weapons & Combat**
Trident,
Totem of Undying

**Rare & Valuable Items**
Elytra,
Enchanted Golden Apple,
Ominous Bottle,
Experience Bottle

**Building Blocks**
Crying Obsidian,
Reinforced Deepslate,
Gilded Blackstone,
Cobweb,
Bell

**Ores**
All Overworld Ores (Stone & Deepslate),
Nether Gold Ore,
Nether Quartz Ore

**Plants & Nature**
Grass,
Dead Bush,
Glow Lichen,
Glow Ink Sac,
Glowstone Dust

**Mushrooms**
Brown Mushroom Block,
Red Mushroom Block,
Mushroom Stem,
Shroomlight

**Amethyst**
Small Bud,
Medium Bud,
Large Bud,
Amethyst Cluster

**Archaeology**
Suspicious Sand,
Suspicious Gravel

**Miscellaneous**
Sea Pickle → Green Dye

## 
## **Other Non Crafting Recipes Added**

**Smelting**
Copper, Gold & Iron Raw Ore Blocks → Ore Blocks,
Rotten Flesh → Leather

**Stonecut**
Gravel → Flint,
Stone →  Cobblestone
